sentences.span: US equities finished the week lower: SPX -182 bps to 7580, NDX -346 bps to 28384
sentences.why: Exact match, same figures also appear independently in 23963__gs-blekos-marketcolour and the level table in 23707__us-equities-weekly-rundown (7,580.07 / 28,384.85 as of Fri 30-Oct-26).

sentences.span: The NDX just matched its biggest monthly decline since the start of the AI cycle (down ~7% in October) as Semis closed down ~8% on Friday, turning in its 3rd largest day of underperformance in >15 years
Risk Control is estimated to sell $75-100 bn on Monday... Risk Control may have more meaningful selling on Tuesday only if SPX drops more than -2%
sentences.why: By Rebecca Cheong (UBS). 'Risk Control' is the systematic vol-targeting category the pulse labels 'volatility-targeting funds' — a faithful translation of desk terminology, not an invented figure.

sentences.span: the S&P 500 to reach our previously identified downside tactical target of 7100-7300 before adding risk more aggressively. Our year-end base case remains 8000
sentences.why: Verbatim match to Mike Wilson's note.

sentences.span: Across the eight companies we track, on-balance sheet debt and lease liabilities total roughly $1.0 trillion. That means for every dollar of debt and leases the AI complex actually reports, there are more than four dollars
Across five leading hyperscalers, these now total $2.8 trillion - an eightfold increase since 2023... S&P adjusts leverage for off-balance-sheet leases, while Moody's and Fitch do not
sentences.why: Correctly attributed to Goldman's Amanda Lynam, per the same article's relay of her comments.

sentences.span: Late-day Excess Flow reversed sharply to +$72bn of buying... from 2:45pm onward... concentrated in Tech ETFs and Semis/Memory stocks
The Russell/NDX ratio has surged... Yet the longer-term downtrend remains firmly intact... Chasing small-cap outperformance here may be just as dangerous as chasing tech was at the highs
sentences.why: Matches the article's framing and closing line almost verbatim.

sentences.span: Russell loves falling rates. The latest bout of small-cap outperformance has moved in perfect lockstep with declining yields.
sentences.why: First clause (falling yields built the rotation) is sourced. The second clause ('so rising ones unwind it') is an added causal claim presented as asserted fact; no source states that rising yields would reverse the rotation.

sentences.span: Fed Chair Warsh acknowledged the tightening already delivered by financial conditions... his comments suggest the bar for a more dovish Fed pivot remains high... he was unwilling to say financial conditions are outright "tight."
sentences.why: Matches exactly, same Morgan Stanley note as s4.

sentences.span: We do not expect core PCE inflation to ease soon and see it ending the year at around 3%... we therefore maintain our forecast of two further rate hikes: one in December and another in Q1 2027, most likely in March
sentences.why: Matches exactly; document is headed 'Generali Asset Management | Market Commentary'. The core-PCE gloss is standard, accurate terminology.

sentences.span: The market is closing the week pricing 18bps of hikes through the end of the year, and ~60bps of hikes through the middle of next year.
sentences.why: Matches exactly for the pricing figures; the UBS no-full-hike-until-Jan'27 claim is independently confirmed in 24067__ubs-s-t-us-hyperscaler-earnings-not-enough: 'The market isn't pricing a full hike until Jan'27, with a total of two hikes not priced until the end of 1H27.'

sentences.span: Wednesday's quarterly refunding is expected to maintain the $125 bn package of $58 bn 3y, $42 bn 10y and $25 bn 30y for November-January

sentences.span: That puts it at odds with Citi, which expects Bessent to slash 20Y and 30Y auction sizes and maybe kill the 20Y altogether... One of them will look smart on Wednesday morning.
sentences.why: A genuine disagreement over the refunding outcome (unchanged sizes per UBS/s13 vs. cuts per Citi/Natixis) is documented in the sources; the sentence has no other checkable content.

sentences.span: That puts it at odds with Citi, which expects Bessent to slash 20Y and 30Y auction sizes and maybe kill the 20Y altogether (Oct 12) because AI is stealing the pension bid.
sentences.why: The Citi half is sourced. No source names a JPMorgan view at all on this topic, let alone the specific claim that cutting long-bond sales would be 'imprudent' because bill demand is 'showing early signs of stalling' — this looks like a fabricated counter-view attached to a real bank name.
